intro: Football is Cape Verde's most popular sport, and the islands punch above their weight.

chapters.title: Football
text: The Blue Sharks reached the AFCON quarter-finals in 2013 and 2024 and qualified for their first World Cup, in 2026.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Windsurfing and kitesurfing on Sal attract world competitions.

places.intro: Where Cape Verde's biggest sporting moments happen.

items.title: World Cup qualification
items.text: One of the smallest nations ever to qualify.
